phases.name: Understand
phases.purpose: Establish objective, scope, constraints, authority and evidence needs.

phases.name: Classify
phases.purpose: Classify task, risk, command surface and workflow.

phases.name: Discover
phases.purpose: Discover existing capabilities, providers, tools, skills and evidence.

phases.name: Probe
phases.purpose: Verify current capability identity, availability, permissions and freshness.

phases.name: LeastPrivilege
phases.purpose: Reduce capability and authority to the minimum necessary scope.

phases.name: Plan
phases.purpose: Construct an evidence-backed bounded plan and acceptance criteria.

phases.name: Preview
phases.purpose: Show consequential effects before mutation where applicable.

phases.name: Approve
phases.purpose: Bind explicit approval to principal, operation, target, scope, effect, expiry, nonce and digest.

phases.name: Execute
phases.purpose: Execute only the approved, currently valid operation.

phases.name: Reconcile
phases.purpose: Compare expected and observed state and preserve conflicts or unknowns.

phases.name: Verify
phases.purpose: Collect independent evidence that execution occurred and matches intended effect.

phases.name: Validate
phases.purpose: Check outcome against requirements, scope, security and privacy.

phases.name: Deliver
phases.purpose: Return only evidence-supported results and explicit uncertainty.

phases.name: Feedback/Learning
phases.purpose: Capture scoped feedback without converting inference into authority.
